the observed drain current degradation in unpassivated GaN MES-FETs can be attributed to surface degradation in the access regions.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the hot carrier degradation phenomena observed in GaN based FETs can be attributed to a drain access resistance degradation due to a generation of deep levels or an increased trapped charge at the device surface.

hot carrier aging degradation phenomena observed in unpassivated GaN MES-FETs can be related to the degradation of surface traps, while the degradation of the epitaxial material is not the main cause of the drain current decrease.
the observed degradation phenomena in GaNs based MESFET can be explained by a combination of surface effects, epitaxial material effects and effects at the interfaces.
The main takeaway from our work is that
hot carrier induced degradation phenomena in GaNs MESFETs is mainly due to the generation of surface traps.
the hot carrier degradation in GaN based devices is not related to the presence of traps at the surface but to the presence of deep level defects in the epitaxial layer and/or at its interfaces.
hot carrier degradation in GaN based devices is not only related with the epitaxial material, but it is also related to the device passivation and to the device processing.
